projects.title: Chatifai - AI Shopify Chatbot
projects.description:
Chatifai is an AI-powered chatbot built with advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system using Pinecone and LLM technology. It automatically analyzes your Shopify store and trains on your knowledge base to provide intelligent, context-aware responses.

Features include fully customizable chatbot widget, modern sales and marketing popups to boost conversions, multilingual support, product recommendations, real-time inventory updates, and live chat with agent handoff. The RAG system ensures accurate responses by retrieving relevant information from your store data, FAQs, and policies. Install and go live in minutes with no coding required.

projects.title: Pro Stitch Global
projects.description: Pro Stitch Global is an ecommerce website built with Laravel. It allows users to shop for custom stitching and tailoring services. This project was built for a client while I was learning and was one of my early client projects.

projects.title: Jimmeflix
projects.description:
Jimmeflix is a comprehensive entertainment hub built with PHP and Laravel. Users can live stream movies and TV series, plus download a wide variety of digital content including games, mobile apps, and PC applications - all in one place.

Features include live video streaming, organized content library, multi-category browsing (movies, series, games, apps), download management, and user-friendly interface. A complete entertainment solution for streaming and downloading across all platforms.

projects.title: Motidhaga - Custom Beaded Accessories
projects.description:
Motidhaga is a custom beaded accessories store where customers can create their own unique piece of jewelry. Personalized bracelets for every occasion — friendship, love, healing & more.

Built with modern ecommerce features including product customization, order management, and secure checkout. Perfect for personalized gift shopping and unique handmade jewelry.

projects.title: AdZen - Ad Blocker
projects.description:
AdZen is a powerful, lightweight ad blocker for modern web. Block ads on YouTube, Twitch & all sites with visual mode. Stop popups, trackers & cookie banners!

Features include YouTube & Twitch ad blocking, universal web protection, GDPR cookie banner removal, ultra-lightweight performance, statistics dashboard, and customizable filter lists. Privacy-first with no data collection. 5.0★ rating with 390+ users.

projects.title: AIVibeDetector
projects.description:
AIVibeDetector is a professional-grade browser extension designed for developers, designers, and digital professionals who need to understand the technology stack and AI involvement of any website instantly.

Detect 150+ technologies with instant analysis (30-650ms), smart caching, dual view interface for AI Detection and Tech Stack views. Features beautiful glassmorphism design, comprehensive reports, and complete privacy-first approach with local analysis. Perfect for web developers, designers, agencies, and tech recruiters.

projects.title: Chat App (MERN Stack)
projects.description: This is a simple chat application where users can chat with each other in real-time. Built using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js).
